risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the fins with the unit fully assembled.

risks.risk: The compressor or thermostat may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit being tested for cooling performance.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the brand and model.
Close-up photo of the cooling fins to check for cracks or blockages.
Video of the unit being tested to confirm it is cooling the engine.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
